properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-18 for Mission Bay's UCSF campus pass: real OSM building footprint. UCSF's own tax-roll record for this address (blklot 8722003) confirms 600 16th St as a UCSF medical/office parcel. BLOCK NUMBER ADDED 2026-09-22: cross-checking both OCII's own Dec 2019 Land Use Map and UCSF's June 2025 CAC presentation (map updated December 2024) confirmed this building is Block 24A/B -- the project's block_inventory brief had wrongly assigned that number to a different, unrelated building (Exchange on 16th/1700 Owens St) since its earliest pass; see docs/briefs/mission_bay_block_inventory.csv for the full correction. Geometry unchanged.
properties.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint, not a hand trace or plan estimate. This is the opposite situation from Mission Bay's condo-mapped residential towers (Avalon, Radiance, etc.): here, ONE large Assessor land parcel spans SEVERAL UCSF buildings (confirmed against data/raw/parcels.geojson and DataSF's Assessor tax roll -- e.g. blklot 8711507 at 675 Nelson Rising Lane alone is ~13 acres, far larger than any single building on it), so using the parcel boundary per building would make multiple records overlap and double-count the same ground. The real building footprint is the only non-overlapping, honest shape for each one.
properties.notes: OCII plan block 24A/B. UCSF's first Mission Bay building and the first structure completed on the 303-acre campus. ~400,000-435,000 sq ft (sources vary), five stories. Architect SmithGroup (SF office). Opened January 2003 (a Jan 8, 2003 first-researcher-moved-in anecdote and a Feb 2003 trade-press "now open" piece support the month; not an official UCSF dedication-date citation).
